body:
## Summary
Improve the wording and information density of the top-level Overview cards and Tool Sources section so the dashboard explains the numbers more clearly and links people to the underlying tools.

## Problem
The current top-level copy is usable, but some labels and supporting text still feel too placeholder-ish for a real usage dashboard.

Examples from the current UI:
- `avg/session` may not be the most useful secondary stat for token cards
- cache read/write is described as secondary context, but the Overview cards do not surface that context very directly
- Tool Sources shows local source paths or `TBD`, but does not yet link to the relevant GitHub repos or explain the adapter/source status in much detail

## Proposed improvements

### Overview cards
- Revisit the secondary line under token cards
- Consider replacing or supplementing `avg/session` with more decision-useful context such as:
  - total cache read tokens
  - total cache write tokens
  - clearer explanation of what is included in `input`, `output`, and `total`
  - better priced/unpriced wording for estimated cost coverage
- Review whether the date range / subtitle copy can better explain what is primary vs secondary context

### Tool Sources section
- Add richer per-tool metadata
- Link each tool card to its GitHub repo / project home when known
- Make the source description more explicit, for example:
  - active data source type
  - what data is currently included in totals
  - what is planned vs implemented
  - what local file / session DB / log source the adapter reads from
- Improve placeholder wording for planned adapters so `TBD` is less bare while still honest

## Acceptance criteria
- Overview card copy is more informative than the current `avg/session` default
- Cache read/write context is surfaced more clearly in the top-level area
- Tool Sources cards can link to the relevant upstream tool repos when available
- Tool cards explain status and source details more clearly than the current placeholder text
- Final wording is concise and still fits the current compact dashboard layout

## Notes
This is primarily a product/UX/content pass, not a data-model rewrite. The goal is to make the top-level dashboard more self-explanatory without losing the compact terminal-style feel.
title: Improve Overview and Tool Sources wording/content
